items.title: Hybe posts record quarterly results as BTS tour lifts revenue

items.description: Two shows from K-pop supergroup BTS' upcoming tour in Taiwan and Jakarta will be livestreamed at movie theaters in more than 80 countries and regions, the group's agency said Tuesday. items.title: K-pop's growing alliance with streaming giants
